title: Accepted electrical fit-out quote
excerpt: Electrical fit-out to the issued floor plan, AUD 4,800 ex GST. After-hours attendance and disposal are outside this scope.

title: After-hours access variation
excerpt: Additional allowance of AUD 400 ex GST for electrical crew attendance after the building's normal access hours.

title: Request to remove old fittings
excerpt: Please price removal of the old fittings. The proposed AUD 200 ex GST disposal charge is awaiting approval.

title: Accepted interior painting quote
excerpt: Prepare existing walls for AUD 280 and apply two coats of interior paint for AUD 700. Both amounts are ex GST.

title: Accepted joinery and visit schedule
excerpt: Install joinery for AUD 600. Site measure and final inspection are separate items of AUD 150 each. The description 'site attendance' alone does not distinguish between them. All figures ex GST.

title: Hardware return visits allowance
excerpt: Return visits to fit replacement hardware share one allowance of AUD 200 ex GST in total.
